Wrong

Ich abhole meine Tochter um vier.

Right

Ich hole meine Tochter um vier ab.

Why

abholen is separable: the verb is in position 2 and ab goes to the end.

mistake-ich-abhole-meine-tochter.md

No German voice is installed on this device, so audio is off. Add a German text-to-speech voice in the device settings.
